messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick heads-up — VertoHealth QBR prep tomorrow. Onboarding batch hit heavy embed/semantic search usage; saw a ~4x token spike last 48h. Need a short ops plan: forecasts, alerts, and immediate throttles.
Jon (FinOps): Ok — can you paste the last 7d token snapshot? I’ll run a spend-forward for 30/60 days.
Aisha (CSM): Pulling now — here's the quick query I ran: 
```
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens_used
FROM redwood_usage
WHERE account = 'vertohealth' AND service='embeddings'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 7;
```
Results: [210k, 190k, 430k, 380k, 400k, 95k, 88k] tokens per day (most recent first).
Priya (Enablement): That looks like an embed-heavy batch job. Any known new flows? onboarding flows, bulk vectorizing?
Aisha (CSM): They onboarded a pilot of full-corpus vectorization for historical notes + nightly refresh. Customer says they expected smaller sample sizes.
Devon (Solutions Eng): We should flip on prefix cache and KV caching for their long-doc flow immediately. Also recommend switching to the cheaper 8-bit quantized embed variant we verified last month.
Jon (FinOps): Forecast quick calc: if 400k/day average continues => ~12M tokens/mo just for embeddings. At current plan that overshoots retainer by ~3.2x. We should propose temporary throttle + retainer top-up.
alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Usage alert — account 'vertohealth' reached 75% of reserved retainer this AM. https://console.prod.redwood/alerts/VERTO-823
Nate (CS Ops): Assigning actions: Priya to write a short enablement note with quick wins, Devon to deploy cache + switch model, Jon to prepare spend scenarios (conservative/likely/worst), Aisha to draft customer communication.
Priya (Enablement): Drafting now. Will include two clipboard-ready suggestions: 1) switch to quantized embed model (~40% token cost reduction in perf tests), 2) enable prefix/KV caching + incremental upserts (avoid full re-vector).
Devon (Solutions Eng): I can push a one-off config change on their Dedicated pool: add prefix_cache: true, kv_incremental: true. ETA 30m. Also will enable model alias `embed-quant-8bit` for them only.
Jon (FinOps): I'll build a mini-runbook with three options: A) temporary throttle to 250k/day + alert at 60% remaining (fast, low customer friction), B) accelerate payment/retainer top-up (sales), C) accept burst and schedule rate-card renegotiation. Will post numbers in 15m.
Aisha (CSM): Good. Can we also add an auto-rollback policy if latency/regressions show up after cache/model switch? We need to guarantee no quality regressions for their POC.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Yes — will add canary: 10% traffic for 15m, compare embeddings similarity score against baseline prompt set. If <95% similarity, rollback. I'll attach metrics.
Priya (Enablement): Customer messaging draft (short): "Quick update — we're seeing a larger-than-expected vectorization run. We're applying caching + a cost-optimized embed model now; this will reduce costs and should not impact quality. If you'd like, we can also throttle bulk runs or add a short-term retainer top-up to avoid interruptions. — Aisha" Want review before I send.
Aisha (CSM): LGTM. Include next steps and a clear CTA: "Approve top-up" or "Enable throttle".
Jon (FinOps): Posted spend scenarios in the doc: https://docs.redwood/qbr/verto-spend-scenarios — TL;DR: throttle keeps them within current retainer for 60 days; top-up needed to keep current ingestion.
Nate (CS Ops): I'll create two budget alerts: 60% and 90% of remaining retainer, and a webhook to this channel. Also creating a temporary rate limit rule: embeddings.max_daily_tokens=250000 (overrides not allowed until CS approval).
alerts-bot: :white_check_mark: Budget alerts created (60%,90%) and rate limit rule staged.
Aisha (CSM): Awesome. Plan: implement cache/model change now (Devon), FinOps sends scenarios to the customer (Jon), I send the message with CTA, and Priya follows with enablement checklist. 30m sync at 1898765800 if needed.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Changes deployed to staging and canary looks clean. Similarity tests within 98%. Rolling to prod canary now.
Jon (FinOps): Scenarios uploaded. Recommend Option A + 1-week monitoring, then decide.
Aisha (CSM): Sending customer message now. Will loop back with outcome. Thanks team :pray:
Nate (CS Ops): Noted — logging action items in the account playbook and creating a follow-up ticket for renewal discussion if top-up persists.
Priya (Enablement): I'll add an onboarding checklist item to prevent full-corpus nightly runs during POC without an agreed retainer.
Aisha (CSM): Last note — capture feedback from Verto on why they ran full corpus now (automation gap?). We want to avoid recurring surprises.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Adding a short telemetry flag to detect bulk vectorize jobs started via API vs UI so we can surface it earlier.
Aisha (CSM): Great — closing the loop. If anything changes ping here or @Nate.
